title: AppService list — app/v1 APP.md `services`
description: Validates the `services` frontmatter array of an AIP-53 APP.md — the app's production hosting surface. One entry = one supervised service process the host runs for the app; there is NO dependency graph, NO scaling and NO scheduler behind it. Names MUST be unique across the array (the loader rejects a duplicate `name` as a load error; JSON Schema 2020-12 cannot express per-key uniqueness, hence the additional `uniqueItems` guard against exact duplicates). This is NOT `dev.launch`: `dev.launch` stays dev-only and is never executed by the loader.

name.description: Service identifier — kebab-case slug, unique across the `services` array.

entry.description: Legacy shell command line that starts the service, e.g. `pnpm --filter x start` or `node dist/server.js`. Carried verbatim; a launcher command, never executed by the loader/`defineApp`. Exactly one of entry/command.

command.description: Structured (preferred) command form: the binary/script to run, never shell-interpreted — the runner passes it as argv[0]. Exactly one of entry/command.

args.description: Structured command form: argv after `command`, passed verbatim. Requires `command`.

cwd.description: Working directory the runner starts the service in; relative paths resolve against the app's installed dir.

port.description: Optional TCP port the service listens on. Omitted = a service that does not listen (no port). One process per entry, one port.
